**I would not approve the pending exporter mapping yet.** Against HEAD `4ca9113cf3b`, two identity ambiguities remain:

- **P2 — Different provider receivers are merged into `provider.go`.** [export-doc-constraints.go:56](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/terraform-provider-xcsh-2421-retrieval-enums/tools/export-doc-constraints.go:56) bypasses destination uniqueness for providers. Two asserted provider types with distinct schema fields produce one combined document; identical overlapping evidence also passes. Reject ambiguous provider ownership before collecting fields.

- **P2 — Multiple Schema declarations for one receiver are combined.** [export-doc-constraints.go:62](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/terraform-provider-xcsh-2421-retrieval-enums/tools/export-doc-constraints.go:62) reuses destination fields without establishing a unique Schema declaration. One Metadata method plus two Schema methods in mutually exclusive platform/build-tagged files can therefore produce a synthetic union: the exporter parses both files, and disjoint fields evade the conflict check. Duplicate Metadata detection does not protect this case. Reject ambiguous schema ownership or select the applicable build files.

These are source-traced counterexamples, not executed reproductions.

The **four-role Metadata helper itself looks sound by inspection**: canonical suffixes match the collection consumer; request and response types must belong to the receiver’s role; assignments reference their parameter objects; conditional, indirect, and repeated writes remain unresolved. Duplicate Metadata receivers and duplicate destinations fail closed. Package-wide assertion conflicts also remain unresolved, and schema selection now receives package-wide contracts.

Remaining proof gaps:

- [identity_test.go:38](/data/robin-GIT/worktrees/terraform-provider-xcsh-2421-retrieval-enums/tools/pkg/docconstraints/identity_test.go:38) claims split-file coverage but puts everything in one file. Existing tests separately exercise resource assertion/factory splits, not the complete assertion → factory → Metadata → Schema split across all four roles.
- Dedicated Metadata tests are missing for request ownership, parameter shadowing, and duplicate receiver declarations.
- Go tests could not run: creating `/tmp/go-build…` failed on the read-only filesystem. `git diff --check` passed.
